name: Okra
summary: Okra is a cultivated vegetable that grows in the tilled plots of Westfall. Highly prized by local homesteaders, it serves as a crucial thickening agent in the region's hearty, improvisational stews.

sections.title: A Staple of Saldean's Farm
sections.body: While much of Westfall lies fallow under the threat of Defias outlaws and rogue harvest golem attacks, stubborn farmers like the Saldeans still manage to coax hearty vegetables out of the soil. Okra grows low and green in the tilled dirt around Saldean's Farm. Despite the harsh conditions of the countryside, the crop persists, providing local homesteaders with essential bulk and nourishment when outside trade and supplies from Stormwind run completely dry.

sections.title: Westfall Stew
sections.body: Okra is best known as the indispensable base for Salma Saldean's famous Westfall Stew. Combined with whatever meat can be hunted across the dusty plains—such as vulture flesh, goretusk snouts, and coastal murloc eyes—the sliced pods break down under heat to thicken thin broths into a filling, restorative meal. For the struggling settlers clinging to their homesteads, fresh pods of okra turn sparse, wild scavenging into a hot, hearty supper.

faq.q: Where does okra grow in Westfall?
faq.answer: Okra grows in the tilled crop patches at Saldean's Farm, situated along the central road of Westfall. Travelers can find the distinctive green plants thriving in the furrows near Farmer Saldean's homestead.

Okra is gathered for Salma Saldean at Saldean's Farm to cook her signature Westfall Stew. Its natural starch thickens the broth, blending harsh ingredients like vulture meat, boar snouts, and murloc eyes into a hearty meal.

faq.q: Why is okra important to the Saldeans?
faq.answer: With trade lines disrupted and the kingdom providing little aid, homesteaders must rely entirely on what they can grow and hunt themselves. Okra is one of the few cultivated crops remaining at Saldean's Farm, keeping the family and passing travelers fed.

angles.text: Any wandering chef knows that a good stew needs more than raw meat; okra provides the necessary starch and body to turn tough wilderness forage into a proper hot meal.
While the nobles of Stormwind dine on imported meats, frontier Alliance homesteaders survive by cultivating stubborn crops like okra amid the ruins of Westfall.
